SSIMULACRA2 image-comparison helper and dependencies

CLI 0.5.2, metric 0.5.1, Rust 1.89.0, aarch64-apple-darwin.
Upstream: https://github.com/rust-av/ssimulacra2
Source revision: 05f2b4e216059c5d735f9665a51648a37d684e70
Image-only build, with statically linked Little CMS.
Normal and build dependency notices are retained below.
The app remains GPL-3.0-or-later; upstream terms remain intact.
